claims.text: After tropical forest clearance, flooding and erosion rates rise and soils can become unable to support crops within a few years; loss of transpiring trees makes the local climate drier and hotter, and burning cleared wood returns stored carbon to the atmosphere as carbon dioxide.

claims.text: Agroforestry can improve soil fertility (especially with nitrogen-fixing trees), shelter crops and livestock from wind, reduce soil erosion and supply fuelwood, fodder and timber, but it is more complex than a single crop and needs effort, time, skill and secure land rights.
